title: BobFWTools Studio — Phoenix Forge
shortDescription: Hardware diagnostics, USB telemetry & firmware workbench companion.
fullDescription:
BobFWTools Studio (Phoenix Forge v5.0.0) provides real-time hardware diagnostics, USB descriptor telemetry, battery health verification, and firmware inventory tracking across Apple iOS/iPadOS and 20+ Android OEM device families.

Key Features:
• Zero-simulation hardware telemetry verification
• Live bench session monitoring & USB cable diagnostics
• Multi-brand device registry (Apple, Samsung, Pixel, Motorola, Xiaomi, OnePlus, Sony, ASUS, Nothing, TCL/REVVL, Qualcomm EDL, MediaTek BROM, Unisoc)
• Encrypted servicing history ledger & technician audit notes
